# status.md — v0.X.Y <Milestone Name>

> Hand-off report written by the Implementer for the Orchestrator and human maintainer.
> Keep entries terse (line anchors + one-line comments) to minimise context and token cost.

## 1. Changes Applied (Line Anchor + One-Line Comment)
- `path/to/file.rs:L15-L35` — Concise one-line summary of the change.
- **Scope Deviation**: None (or list any deviation and its rationale).

## 2. Tests (Added X / Modified Y / Deleted Z)
- `path/to/file.rs:L120-L135` (`test_name`) — One-line description of what the test verifies (may be omitted with a note when directly self-evident from Section 1).

## 3. Verification Result
- **Command**: `bash scripts/check.sh` (plus any additional manual/smoke command)
- **Output Summary**: Exit code, passed/failed counts, and warning count.

## 4. Blockers & Decisions Required
- Edge cases, known trade-offs, or decisions requiring Orchestrator/human judgement (or `None`).
